## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: broad sector participation (10/11 sectors positive) and concentrated leadership in Industrials while mega-cap Technology shows short-term weakness; Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Industrials).

**2. Which sectors are leading?**  
Industrials lead: LMT ABOVE TREND (1W: +13.83% | 1M: +14.85%), RTX ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.33% | 1M: +17.06%), MMM ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.51% | 1M: +7.43%). Communication also strong: T ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.25% | 1M: +10.38%), VZ ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.78% | 1M: +4.46%). Energy showing strength: SLB ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.08% | 1M: +8.67%), XOM ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.32% | 1M: +12.52%).

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**  
Technology lagging: sector 1W: -1.32% with notable weakness in large caps. GOOGL BELOW TREND (1W: -7.22% | 1M: -4.99%), INTC BELOW TREND (1W: -5.55% | 1M: -31.01%), MSFT in CORRECTION (1W: -3.28% | 1M: +10.28%). Consumer Staples and Financials are modestly positive but behind Industrials on 1W performance.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**  
Top 5: GM ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.42% | 1M: +10.25%), LMT ABOVE TREND (1W: +13.83% | 1M: +14.85%), RTX ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.33% | 1M: +17.06%), MMM ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.51% | 1M: +7.43%), T ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.25% | 1M: +10.38%). Leadership: Narrow (3/5 Industrials) — favors cyclical exposure.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**  
Bottom 5: DOW BELOW TREND (1W: -5.33% | 1M: -1.91%), UBER BELOW TREND (1W: -5.53% | 1M: -5.63%), INTC BELOW TREND (1W: -5.55% | 1M: -31.01%), CCI BELOW TREND (1W: -6.37% | 1M: -9.75%), GOOGL BELOW TREND (1W: -7.22% | 1M: -4.99%). Weakness concentrated in select Tech and infra names.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**  
Strongest 1W momentum: GM (1W: +14.42%), LMT (1W: +13.83%), RTX (1W: +12.33%), MMM (1W: +11.51%), T (1W: +11.25%), SLB (1W: +11.08%). Major divergence present: several mega-caps (MSFT, NVDA, META, AMZN) show 1W negative vs 1M positive (CORRECTION) — tactical long/short opportunities, not broad confirmation.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**  
Mixed with CORRECTION pattern for many leaders: MSFT CORRECTION (1W: -3.28% | 1M: +10.28%), NVDA CORRECTION (1W: -3.33% | 1M: +0.39%), META CORRECTION (1W: -8.05% | 1M: +9.39%), AAPL ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.16% | 1M: +22.45%). Sector breadth: Technology negative on 1W (24 stocks, 1W: -1.32%) — watch for consolidation or renewed leadership.

**8. Financials Outlook?**  
Solid and broadly ABOVE TREND: JPM ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.11% | 1M: +6.77%), V ABOVE TREND (1W: +0.54% | 1M: +9.68%), MA ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.49% | 1M: +11.78%). Sector breadth: Financials net positive (20 stocks, 1W: +0.54%) — supports a Value/Cyclical style tilt.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**  
Defensive bid but selective rotation: JNJ ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.88% | 1M: +8.60%), LLY ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.41% | 1M: +6.19%), UNH in CORRECTION (1W: -0.93% | 1M: +0.51%). Sector breadth: Healthcare positive (17 stocks, 1W: +2.13%) — resilience amid tech churn.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**  
Favor Industrials/Financials/Energy exposure (examples: LMT ABOVE TREND, RTX ABOVE TREND, JPM ABOVE TREND, XOM ABOVE TREND) and reduce exposure to the most strained mega-cap Tech where 1W weakness meets 1M gains (MSFT CORRECTION, NVDA CORRECTION, GOOGL BELOW TREND). Monitor the major divergence—tactical entries may exist, but wait for follow-through before expanding core positions.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: LMT ABOVE TREND (1W: +13.83% | 1M: +14.85%), RTX ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.33% | 1M: +17.06%), GM ABOVE TREND (1W: +14.42% | 1M: +10.25%). BEARISH: GOOGL BELOW TREND (1W: -7.22% | 1M: -4.99%), INTC BELOW TREND (1W: -5.55% | 1M: -31.01%), TSLA BELOW TREND (1W: -16.33% | 1M: -17.57%).

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: Industrials (1W: +4.45%, 15 stocks), Energy (1W: +1.06% | 1M: +12.15%). BEARISH: Technology (24 stocks, 1W: -1.32%) — tech flows will determine whether rotation persists or breadth narrows.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**  
NVDA CORRECTION (1W: -3.33% | 1M: +0.39%): watch for upside follow-through above recent swing highs for confirmation. AAPL ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.16% | 1M: +22.45%): holding near trend supports risk-on stance. JPM ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.11% | 1M: +6.77%): breakout continuation would reinforce Financials leadership.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**  
RTX (+80): RTX ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.33% | 1M: +17.06%) — bullish news (raised outlook) is confirming price strength. ABT (+80): ABT ABOVE TREND (news positive) — monitor for follow-through (price confirming on week). (Note: RTX confirmation shown above; ABT flagged by high sentiment — monitor execution).

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**  
UNH (-50): UNH CORRECTION (1W: -0.93% | 1M: +0.51%) — policy headwind is a clear risk and price shows short-term softening. XOM (-50): XOM ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.32% | 1M: +12.52%) — analyst downgrade is diverging from price strength; watch for distribution.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, favor Value/Cyclical style given Industrials and Energy leadership. LMT ABOVE TREND, RTX ABOVE TREND and GM ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: major divergence in mega-cap Tech (MSFT CORRECTION, NVDA CORRECTION, META CORRECTION) — monitor for trend breaks and sentiment-driven reversals.
